mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESUME R LEFT JOIN WORKER W ON (R.WORKER_NO = W.WORKER_NO) LEFT JOIN "MEMBER" M ON (W.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO) WHERE RESUME_DEL_FL = 'N' AND RESUME_HIDE_FL = 'N' AND MEMBER_DEL_FL = 'N'

WITH BASE_DATA AS
( SELECT DISTINCT
R.RESUME_NO AS "resumeNo", M.MEMBER_EMAIL AS "memberEmail", M.MEMBER_NAME AS "memberName", W.PROFILE_IMG AS "profileImg", W.WORKER_MBTI AS "workerMbti", R.MODIFICATION_DATE, R.REGISTRATION_DATE, SUBSTR(M.MEMBER_TEL, 1, 3) || '-' || SUBSTR(M.MEMBER_TEL, 4, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(M.MEMBER_TEL, 8, 4) "memberTel", SUBSTR(W.WORKER_ADDRESS, INSTR(W.WORKER_ADDRESS, '^^^') + 3, (INSTR(W.WORKER_ADDRESS, ' ', 1, 2) - (INSTR(W.WORKER_ADDRESS, '^^^') + 3))) "memberAddress", '만 ' || FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(SYSDATE), W.WORKER_BIRTHDATE) / 12) || '세' AS "age", TO_CHAR(W.WORKER_BIRTHDATE, 'YYYY') || '년생' AS "workerBirthDate",
LISTAGG(CI.COMPANY_NAME || '-' || CI.CAREER_DESCRIPTION || '&&&' || CASE -- END_DATE가 NULL인 경우 WHEN END_DATE IS NULL THEN '근무중(' || CASE WHEN FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, START_DATE) / 12) > 0 AND TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, START_DATE), 12)) > 0 THEN FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, START_DATE) / 12) || '년 ' || TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, START_DATE), 12)) || '개월)' WHEN FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, START_DATE) / 12) > 0 THEN FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, START_DATE) / 12) || '년)' WHEN TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, START_DATE), 12)) > 0 THEN TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, START_DATE), 12)) || '개월)' ELSE '1개월 미만)' END -- END_DATE가 NULL이 아닌 경우 WHEN FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(END_DATE, START_DATE) / 12) > 0 AND TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(END_DATE, START_DATE), 12)) > 0 THEN FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(END_DATE, START_DATE) / 12) || '년 ' || TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(END_DATE, START_DATE), 12)) || '개월' WHEN FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(END_DATE, START_DATE) / 12) > 0 THEN FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(END_DATE, START_DATE) / 12) || '년' WHEN TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(END_DATE, START_DATE), 12)) > 0 THEN TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(END_DATE, START_DATE), 12)) || '개월' ELSE '1개월 미만' END , '^^^') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CI.COMPANY_NAME || '-' || CI.CAREER_DESCRIPTION) OVER(PARTITION BY R.RESUME_NO) AS "carrerStr"
FROM RESUME R LEFT JOIN WORKER W ON (R.WORKER_NO = W.WORKER_NO) LEFT JOIN "MEMBER" M ON (W.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN RESUME_CAREER RCA ON (R.RESUME_NO = RCA.RESUME_NO) LEFT JOIN CAREER_INFO CI ON (RCA.CAREER_NO = CI.CAREER_NO) WHERE RESUME_DEL_FL = 'N' AND RESUME_HIDE_FL = 'N' AND MEMBER_DEL_FL = 'N' ORDER BY CASE WHEN R.MODIFICATION_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN R.MODIFICATION_DATE ELSE R.REGISTRATION_DATE END DESC )
SELECT DISTINCT R.*, LISTAGG(EW.WORKTYPE_CATEGORY, ' / ') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY EW.WORKTYPE_CATEGORY) OVER(PARTITION BY "resumeNo") AS "workCategory"
FROM BASE_DATA R JOIN RESUME_WORKTYPE RW ON (RW.RESUME_NO = R."resumeNo") JOIN EMPLOYER_WORKTYPE EW ON (EW.WORKTYPE_NO = RW.WORKTYPE_NO)
